title: Get Cultured
author: Vince
description: Get Cultured is a podcast about becoming a more interesting person by exploring everything the world has to offer. Each episode brings in an expert to introduce us to something worth knowing, experiencing, or learning—from travel, food and wine to history, art, style, adventure, and unusual skills. Discover new interests, find your next adventure, and become the most interesting man in the room.
